200.description: The published version. A replay of the first answer carries Idempotency-Replayed: true.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response is a replay of the first answer.

version.description: The policy version; 0 is the built-in default (nothing published).

crossRegionSurchargeCents.description: Added to the effective cost of a candidate whose node region differs from the delivery area region (both known). 0 = off.

maxCostDeviationPercent.description: The regional budget: among candidates whose effective cost is within cheapest + floor(cheapest * percent / 100), an in-region candidate beats a cross-region one. 0 = off.

publishedAt.description: When the version was published. Absent on version 0.

400.description: idempotency-key-required (no Idempotency-Key header) or idempotency-key-invalid (not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters), or malformed-request (no body, not valid JSON, a field that is not an integer, an unknown field, trailing data, or a NUL character).

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

405.description: method-not-allowed, the method is not served on this path.

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

409.description: concurrent-update (another publish took the same version number; retry with a new Idempotency-Key) or idempotency-key-reused (the key was already used with a different request).

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response is a replay of the first answer.

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

422.description: validation-failed (ErrValidation), crossRegionSurchargeCents outside 0..100000 or maxCostDeviationPercent outside 0..200.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response is a replay of the first answer.

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

example.title: Validation failed
example.detail: validation failed: maxCostDeviationPercent must be between 0 and 200

500.description: internal-error, an unexpected failure (the detail never carries the internal message).
